text: The replacement keeps selected indices and row count, compares them after expansion and passes the resulting selectionDidChange decision to onSelectionChanged. The accepted branch also tracks restoration state. Same URI alone does not prove the selection or view state is unchanged. Preserve the current membership/count boundary when optimizing notification work; later source was read only as context, with no later chronology coverage. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Compare selection membership and row count before suppressing notification
